name: Omamessage
author: charleschao
description: Requires Tether by Zack Bartel installed separately (github.com/zackb/tether). Omarchy bar widget for iPhone SMS/iMessage, notifications, clipboard, and files via the local tether CLI — not a standalone messenger.

barWidget.description: Requires Tether (Zack Bartel, github.com/zackb/tether) installed separately. Messages, notifications, clipboard, files, and Bluetooth settings via the local CLI.

installation.note: This plugin requires additional setup before it can be enabled. Follow the upstream installation instructions.
